stages.name: dyad
stages.claim: classical kernel inference: one known source, so bin the update delta by the discrepancy d

stages.name: recover
stages.claim: with a known source and no retention, the binned mean recovers lambda k(d)

stages.name: network
stages.claim: on a network the source is unknown, so the analyst regresses on the mean discrepancy d_bar

stages.name: problems
stages.claim: the same estimator is flattened: averaging over neighbours and over non-movers shrinks the kernel
